name: Pixel Penguin
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: On-chain detective ZachXBT tweeted that a Rug Pull occurred on Pixel Penguin, a charity project created by Hopeexist1, which claimed to raise funds to help him fight cancer. At present, the social accounts of Hopeexist1 and Pixel Penguin have been deleted, and the Pixel Penguin contract is worth only $117,000 (61.686 ETH).
